items.title: 52300_Trummy Young oral history interview
items.q: Zooty was playing with Roy then, and so was Scoop Carry on alto.

ctx.x: I saw in Chilton that during that period you worked with them and they also mentioned Roy Eldridge.

I played with Roy. Not steady, but I played with Roy down there at that -- what club -- it was some club down there in the Loop he was playing. Zooty was playing with Roy then, and so was Scoop Carry on alto.
